title: Get Lowpoly Working End to End
description: Fix lowpoly plugin build and get it working end to end. Compile error: WindowMeasure::Slider missing fields `loading` and `ready` in lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Dev command `dev:lowpoly` fails during plugin build.
summary: Lowpoly plugin failed to compile because WindowMeasure::Slider gained required `ready` and `loading` fields (fill-slider loading ring work). Added `ready: None, loading: None` to both slider constructors in lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Verified: plugin builds for wasm32-wasip2, `SEMIO_RENDERER=react bun run dev:lowpoly` serves at http://127.0.0.1:6078/, Playwright boot shows title `semio · lowpoly`, canvas present, Edit/Paint chrome, and a default lowpoly mesh with no page errors.
